profile.summary: Restoration Management Company is a company that provides emergency disaster restoration and cleanup services, including water damage restoration, fire and smoke damage cleanup, mold remediation and environmental remediation. It also offers construction and technical services for electronics and equipment. It serves clients such as healthcare, hospitality, schools and government agencies in several western and southern states.
